text: Most of the week's 71 pull requests in BCApps were fixes that change behaviour, and none are marked breaking. Posting and inventory got the most attention: #14490 stops repeated partial return postings from reusing the first credit memo, #13885 keeps the item's Gen. Prod. Posting Group off the prepayment deduction line, and #14506 and #14240 clear the "Cannot match item tracking" error on partial inventory picks. Other fixes cover Lot-for-Lot planning (#14243), production order finishing (#13562) and reversed output (#14450, #12153). Regional work includes the 2026 ELSTER XML export (#14448), Norwegian SAF-T exchange rates (#14437), ZUGFeRD Description 2 (#14500, #14501) and Mexican cash basis VAT (#13015). #14507 and #13854 make Set G/L Account No. respect filters. In Job Queue, #14499 resumes interrupted finalization and #14485 applies Job Timeout to re-created tasks. The agent apps moved most on features: Expense Agent gained interim approval (#13674), lost-receipt expenses (#14528) and general availability (#14492), while custom agents got native Markdown instructions (#13831) and timeline task creation (#13811). #14372 moves Business Skills core into System Application. For partners, #14650, #13200 and #14346 add extensibility, and #14405 renumbers three Expense Agent codeunits to avoid collisions.

issues: "Posting and inventory got the most attention" and "the agent apps moved most on features" are the writer's interpretation, not facts from the list, though both are plausible.
Calling #12153 "reversed output" is a slight simplification: it fixes the Adjust Cost variance entries created after a finished production order is reversed and its output posted again.
